blocks.text: Fundamental particle (bunyadi zarra) woh hai jis ki koi andaruni banawat na ho, yani jise mazeed toda na ja sake. Aaj maadde ke bunyadi hisse quarks (protons, neutrons aur mesons quarks se bane hain) aur leptons (electrons, positrons aur neutrinos waghaira) mane jate hain. Yahi maadde ki bunyadi eentein (building blocks) hain.

Jab nucleus ko bohat zyada energy wale particle accelerator mein toda jaye, ya do zyada energy wale zarre takrayein, to bilkul naye qism ke zarre bante hain jo aam maadde ke atoms mein maujood nahi lagte. Yeh un zordar takkaron ka nateeja hain jo maadde ki bunyadi banawat jaanchne ke liye ki jati hain. Sau se zyada naye zarre pehchane gaye aur milti julti khususiyat ke khandanon (families) mein baante gaye. In mein se bohat se theoretical physicists ke nizam (scheme) mein theek baith gaye, aur baqi ko “strange particles” kaha gaya. Yeh hamesha joron mein bante hain; maslan jab pion (π⁻) proton se takrata hai to do strange zarre K⁰ aur Λ⁰ bante hain (kitab chhota k likhti hai):

Tamam zarre apne mehwar (axis) par ghoomte (spin) hain, aur charged zarron ka spin unhein nanhe magnets bana deta hai. Electrons, protons aur neutrons ka spin 1/2, photon ka 1 aur pions ka zero hai. Aadhe (½) spin wale zarre Pauli ke exclusion principle par chalte hain: ek qism ka sirf ek zarra kisi ek quantum state mein reh sakta hai. Inhein “fermions” kehte hain. Zero ya poore adad (whole number) spin wale zarre is usool par nahi chalte; yeh Bose-Einstein statistics par chalte hain aur “bosons” kehlate hain. Mazeed bari taqseem yeh hai:

items: Nucleons aur un se bhaari zarre jaise Λ⁰, jo decay ho kar nucleons bante hain, “baryons” (bhaari) kehlate hain.
Muons nucleons se strong asar nahi karte; inhein electrons, tau aur neutrinos ke saath leptons (halke, chhote) kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab baryons ki misal mein Λ⁰ ke saath k⁰ (K⁰) bhi likhti hai. K⁰ (kaon) baryon nahi balke meson hai: yeh ek quark aur ek antiquark (d aur anti-s) se bana hai aur decay ho kar nucleon nahi banta. Kitab ka apna box (topic 12.8) bhi kaons ko mesons mein ginta hai. Is liye yahan baryon ki misal sirf Λ⁰ hai.

Dono qism ke β-decay (beta-minus aur beta-plus) is baat ka saboot hain ke protons aur neutrons bunyadi zarre nahi (in ke andar tabdeeli hoti hai). 1960s tak neutron aur proton jaise bohat se naye zarre mile, aur bohat se “darmiyani” (midsized) zarre bhi jinhein mesons kaha gaya; in ke masses zyada tar nucleons se kam magar electron se zyada the (baad mein mile kuch mesons nucleons se bhaari hain). Strong asar wale zarre π meson ya pions kehlaye, aur kamzor asar wale μ mesons ya muons (aaj muons ko leptons gina jata hai).
Is daryaft se yeh nateeja nikla ke yeh zarre bunyadi nahi ho sakte; yeh aur chhote hisson se bane hone chahiye, jinhein quarks ka naam diya gaya.

Zarron ko un par lagne wali chaar fundamental forces ke lihaz se bhi baanta ja sakta hai. Gravity har zarre par lagti hai magar sub-atomic satah par is ka asar itna kam hai ke aam taur par nazar-andaz kar dete hain. Electromagnetic force sab charged zarron par lagti hai aur achhi tarah samjhi hui hai; zaroorat par ise shamil karte hain, magar is chapter mein zyada tar nazar-andaz karenge.

Bari taqseem is baat par hai ke zarra strong force mehsoos karta hai ya nahi. Jo strong force mehsoos karte hain woh hadrons hain, aur jo nahi karte woh leptons. Hadrons ki misalein: protons, neutrons aur pions; leptons ki misalein: electrons aur neutrinos.

Hadrons murakkab (composite, chhote hisson se bane) zarre hain, jin ki do qismein hain: kuch bosons hain jinhein mesons kehte hain (maslan pion), aur kuch fermions hain jinhein baryons kehte hain (khaas misalein protons aur neutrons). Baryons taaq (odd) tadaad ke quarks se bane hain (aam taur par teen), aur mesons juft (even) tadaad se (aam taur par do: ek quark aur ek antiquark).

blocks.alt: Darakht (tree) khaaka: sab se oopar Particles; is se do shakhein, Hadrons (strong force mehsoos karte hain) aur Leptons (strong force mehsoos nahi karte: electron, muon, tau aur un ke neutrinos). Hadrons ki do shakhein: Baryons (3 quarks: proton, neutron) aur Mesons (quark + antiquark: pion).
blocks.caption: Zarron ki khandani taqseem: hadrons (baryons aur mesons) aur leptons (hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.text: Leptons sirf weak ya electromagnetic forces se asar karte hain. Koi tajurba ab tak leptons ke andar koi banawat nahi dhoond saka; yeh sach mein bunyadi zarre lagte hain jo toote nahi ja sakte. Tamam leptons ka spin ½ hai, is liye sab fermions hain. Chhe maloom leptons teen joron mein hain (Table 12.3). Har jore mein ek charged zarra (e⁻, μ⁻, τ⁻), us ka neutrino, aur in ke anti-particles hain. Charged leptons doosre zarron ke saath mil kar atoms aur positronium jaise murakkab zarre banate hain, jabke neutrinos kisi cheez se mushkil se asar karte hain, is liye shaz-o-nadir hi dekhe jate hain. Sab se mashhoor lepton electron hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab charged leptons ko '(e⁻, m⁻, t⁻)' likhti hai; m aur t chhapai ki ghalti hai. Sahi alamatein muon ke liye μ⁻ aur tau ke liye τ⁻ hain. Isi tarah Table 12.3 mein muon neutrino 'νₘ' chhapa hai, sahi ν_μ hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Table ko yun parhein: har khandan mein ek charged lepton (charge −1) aur us ka neutrino (charge 0) hai, aur har ek ka anti-particle ulte charge wala hai. Electron sab se halka (0.511 MeV/c²), muon taqreeban 207 guna aur tau taqreeban 3500 guna bhaari hai. Neutrinos ka mass bohat hi kam hai (1 eV, yani 10⁻⁶ MeV, se bhi kam); kitab ki alamat '»' ka matlab yahan 'taqreeban/is se kam' samjhein.

blocks.prompt: Fermions aur bosons mein farq bataiye (short question 12.6). Meson boson hai ya fermion; wajah dijiye (constructed response 12.2). Misalon ke saath hadrons aur leptons mein farq bataiye (short question 12.12).
blocks.explanation: Fermions ka spin aadha adad (1/2) hai, Pauli ke exclusion principle par chalte hain aur electrons, protons, neutrons aur quarks shamil hain; bosons ka spin sifar ya poora adad hai, Bose-Einstein statistics par chalte hain aur photons, gluons, pions aur Higgs boson shamil hain. Meson quark aur antiquark se bana hai, do spin-1/2 zarre jin ke spins mil kar poora adad (0 ya 1) dete hain, to woh boson hai. Hadrons strong force mehsoos karte aur quarks se bane hain (protons, neutrons, pions); leptons strong force mehsoos nahi karte aur un ki koi maloom andaruni banawat nahi (electrons, muons, neutrinos).

items: Bunyadi zarra: koi andaruni banawat nahi; quarks aur leptons. Zyada energy ki takkarein sau se zyada zarre banati hain; strange zarre joron mein bante hain (π⁻ + p → K⁰ + Λ⁰).

Spin ½: fermions (Pauli exclusion); spin 0 ya 1: bosons (Bose-Einstein). Hadrons strong force mehsoos karte hain: baryons (3 quarks; p, n) aur mesons (quark + antiquark; pions). Leptons nahi karte: e, μ, τ aur un ke neutrinos (Table 12.3).
